summary: Tested Meal Purchases + Expense Report feature end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed (categories CRUD + admin gate, purchase upsert with comma/negative/zero handling, GET list, bulk-upload CSV+XLSX+txt-reject with TOTAL footer skip and unmatched columns, expense-report bucketing athletes vs staff + totals + avg cost + 400 range validations, chef allowed / member forbidden across all endpoints). Frontend: admin login, /admin/meals-report shows all 4 tabs (daily, monthly, expenses, purchases). Expense report tab: month/date-range toggle, month picker, from/to inputs, 3 summary cards (expenses/meals/avg), table with totals row, CSV download triggers file (meal_expenses_2026-08-01_2026-08-17.csv), Print button present. Purchases tab: 5 category inputs, day-total live-updates (₹750 from 250+500), Save persists (success toast + row appears in Last-30-days table with today 2026-08-17), template CSV downloads, Categories manager modal opens. Regression: /api/reports/calendar-grid?month=2026-08 returns 200; Daily & Monthly grid tabs still load.

minor.issue: Inconsistent with PUT: bulk-upload stores zero amounts (e.g. chicken_mutton=0.0) rather than dropping them like PUT /meals/purchases/{date} does. Cosmetic — reports still sum correctly — but leaves stray 0 entries in the amounts map.

action_items: (Minor, optional) Align bulk-upload with PUT to drop zero amounts instead of persisting {key: 0.0}.
critical_code_review_comments: meals.py is now ~1327 lines — well past the 700-line comfort limit. Consider splitting purchases/expense-report block into a separate router module.
expense-report avg_cost_per_meal is computed even when purchases exist but total_meals=0 (returns None correctly), but when meals>0 and expenses=0 it still returns 0.0 which is fine — no fix needed.
Bulk-upload consistency (see minor issue) — recommend threading zero-drop through _parse_amount usage in bulk import path.
